channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Tehran Accuses U.S. of ‘Reckless’ Attacks After Exchange of Fire in Strait
item.description: The United States attacked Iranian targets after strikes on American ships, despite a proposed peace plan. The United States said it had attacked Iranian military targets in response to strikes on American ships.

item.title: Trump says ceasefire still in effect as Iran calls Strait of Hormuz attacks "point of no return"
item.description: US President Trump stated a ceasefire with Iran remains in effect after recent attacks on the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Foreign Minister described the attacks as a "point of no return", escalating tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Trump calls Iran attacks a 'trifle' but says ceasefire holds: Live updates
item.description: Trump claimed the Iran war ceasefire holds, despite ongoing attacks between the US and Iran. Trump says Iran war ceasefire holds, despite attacks: Live updates USA Today. Trump calls Iran attacks a 'trifle' but says ceasefire holds: Live updates USA Today.

item.title: UAE reports drone, missile attack as ceasefire is challenged
item.description: The UAE reported a drone and missile attack, challenging a ceasefire. Iran and the US had earlier traded fire, with President Trump dismissing the attacks as minor. Iran and U. S.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of breaching Victory Day ceasefire
item.description: Russia and Ukraine accused each other of breaching a ceasefire hours after it began, with both sides reporting hundreds of drone attacks. The truce was meant to cover Victory Day celebrations.

item.title: U.A.E. Expels Pakistani Workers, as Pakistan’s Peacemaking Creates a Rift
item.description: The UAE is expelling Pakistani workers as Pakistan's ties to the Emirates deteriorate. As Pakistan mediates between the U. S. and Iran, its ties to the Emirates have deteriorated. Pakistani workers say they are now being sent home en masse.

item.title: Worldwide race to trace passengers from hantavirus-hit cruise ship
item.description: A global effort is underway to trace passengers from the MV Hondius cruise ship, linked to a hantavirus outbreak. At least 12 countries have been connected to the ship, with the UN health agency confirming five cases of the virus.

item.title: China confirms its support to Pakistan during last year’s war with India
item.description: China provided technical support to Pakistan during its four-day war with India last May. An aviation engineer was involved in the assistance, according to China's South China Morning Post. China’s South China Morning Post said an aviation engineer provided technical support to Pakistan during the four-day war last May.

item.title: New govt intent on initiating swift systemic change
item.description: Peter Magyar's new government aims to initiate rapid systemic change. The cabinet is set to be sworn in, but a resignation has already occurred, and questions linger about Magyar's policy on Ukraine.

item.title: Trump says ceasefire still in place after US and Iran exchange fire
item.description: US President Trump confirmed a ceasefire with Iran remains in place following an exchange of fire between the two countries. The situation escalated tensions, but Trump maintained that the ceasefire agreement holds.

item.title: The disaster unfolding on Russia’s Black Sea coast is of its own making
item.description: Russian pollution is spreading across southern Russia, exposing environmental collapse under Putin's system. The disaster unfolding on the Black Sea coast is a result of years of neglect and mismanagement of the country's environmental policies.

item.title: Cyber attack disrupts swathe of US and Canada universities and schools
item.description: A hacking group breached the academic software Canvas, used by thousands of schools and universities across North America. The cyber attack disrupted a swathe of US and Canada universities and schools, causing widespread disruption to teaching and learning.

item.title: What are Africa's options during the Hormuz crisis?
item.description: The ongoing blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is affecting African nations badly. African nations are exploring potential solutions to mitigate the drastic effects of the crisis, including alternative shipping routes and diversifying their energy sources.

item.title: Iran claims to have seized ‘offending’ oil tanker in Gulf of Oman
item.description: Iranian forces boarded and detained the Barbados-flagged oil tanker Ocean Koi in the Gulf of Oman. State TV released a video of the IRGC forces detaining the vessel, which Iran claims was involved in "offending" activities.

item.title: US says expecting peace proposal response from Tehran today
item.description: A ceasefire held despite recent strikes by Iran and the US. Israel conducted a hit in Lebanon amid the ongoing conflict. Iran war live: Ceasefire holds despite Iran, US blows; Israel hits Lebanon Al Jazeera.

item.title: 3 Hikers Dead After Volcano Erupts in Indonesia
item.description: Three hikers died after Mount Dukono erupted in Indonesia. Indonesian authorities had previously closed the volcano to climbers due to volcanic activity, but some hikers were still on the mountain when it erupted, forcing others to evacuate safely.

item.title: Hantavirus Confirmed: Two British Nationals Test Positive
item.description: Two British nationals have tested positive for hantavirus. The confirmation was made through medical testing, though further details about the cases are not provided. Two British Nationals test positive for hantavirus.

item.title: New Suspected Hantavirus Case Identified On Remote South Atlantic Island
item.description: A new suspected hantavirus case was identified on a remote South Atlantic island. The British health security agency is monitoring the situation. The British health security agency did not disclose further details of the new suspected case.

item.title: ’ How city residents can help protect migratory birds
item.description: City residents can help protect migratory birds. Simple actions at home can contribute to their conservation during their silent migrations. Did you know that millions of birds may be migrating silently overhead right now as you read this – and you don’t even need to leave the house to see them?

item.title: Three dead after volcano erupts on Indonesian island
item.description: Three people died after a volcano erupted on an Indonesian island. Officials had warned of safety concerns and risks associated with climbing the active volcano. Officials had previously issued warnings on climbing the active volcano due to safety concerns.
